response.sql: WITH major_counts AS (SELECT link_to_major, COUNT(*) AS member_count FROM member GROUP BY link_to_major), shares AS (SELECT link_to_major, member_count, 1.0 * member_count / SUM(member_count) OVER () AS share FROM major_counts), shares_with_average AS (SELECT member_count, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share FROM shares) SELECT SUM(member_count) AS total_members, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(share - average_share) AS average_amount_above_share FROM shares_with_average WHERE share > average_share;
